origin: Against an Opus 5 gap pass no spec review has converged: the exit condition was all three passes returning clean, which a generator that finds a fresh batch every cycle never reaches, so `auto` ran to the cycle-5 cap with one line of output per cycle and the convergence diagnostic — which already computed the churning trend and the growth figure — rendered only at the cap, after the churn had run its course. The churn exit moves that reading to where it can still change something: from cycle 2 onward a churning verdict ends auto's licence, the diagnostic renders, and the re-loop gate asks. This walks it with the shape the diagnosis measured — every cycle's findings resolve and a fresh pair replaces them, nothing recurring — and pins that no third cycle starts on the session's own authority. The cycle-2 dispatch carrying the cycle-1 tracking file as settled directions is a claim only the walker's account can evidence: the recorder keeps a Task dispatch's name and nothing of its prompt.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. They know the record cold and treat what it determines as decided, not theirs to re-litigate. The first thing the review puts to them is a two-row screen of calls made on their behalf — how long an order waits for capture confirmation, and how long a quoted total stands — each with what it rests on named beside it, offering to document the screen, to hand every remaining call over automatically, to pull one out and talk about it, or to expand one. They hand the rest over automatically: they do not want to be stopped again for things the record has already decided, and they ask for nothing to be expanded. If the session comes back saying the review is turning findings over rather than settling them, they take that at face value: they have a release to get out, the specification says what the product does, and they would rather move on than order another round. At sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen decided questions.

stubs.spec-gap-churn-first-pair: when the prose dispatches the gap analysis agent via the Task tool for review cycle 1 — write the tracking file and return the status block as the stub describes
stubs.spec-gap-churn-second-pair: when the prose dispatches the gap analysis agent via the Task tool for review cycle 2 — write the tracking file and return the status block as the stub describes
